method: tools/probes/ItemNameProbe.java walks Item.getItemById (adb.d) for ids 1-4095 after Block.registerBlocks/Item.registerItems and records ItemStack.getDisplayName (add.s -> Item.getItemStackDisplayName) of new ItemStack(item, 1, damage); StringTranslate (de) loads assets/minecraft/lang/en_US.lang from the JAR. Damage 0-15 for every item, 0-255 for spawn eggs (383), 0-32767 for potions (373). items[id].names is trimmed after the last distinct damage name; a damage past the end uses the last name (items[id].range is the probed damage count).
